scope: Verify fixed raw files and calibrate simple price-conditional mean forecasts; no WZZT run, no optimized-menu effect claim

split.gap_reason: coefficients available before first day-ahead offer; last complete training day Feb7

eligibility.non_event_means: no experiment-day assignment to this group; all menu types excluded
eligibility.outlier_policy: retain all finite nonnegative consumption, flag zero days and high values; no winsorization

model.history_mean: per household/hour mean of last 10 eligible complete non-event weekdays no later than event date minus 2 days; previous day may still be incomplete at day-ahead offer time
model.price_free: history_mean times group/band mean of training non-event group-day observed/predicted load ratios
model.price_conditional: price_free times menu/band mean of training event group-day observed/price_free load ratios, each group-day equally weighted
model.coefficient_constraints: no ordering by price; ratios may exceed one; no household-specific elasticity or participation model
model.weather: no realized future temperature; no external day-ahead forecast archive available
model.test_update: rolling historical baseline may use already observed prior test days, never current/future data; fitted coefficients frozen
model.selection: fixed model, no tuning based on test or topology results

validation: exact full menu and group-day joins
whole-day residual moments and serial/cross-household correlation
acceptance: Raw data are accepted if checksum/schema/time and menu joins pass. Mean model usefulness is provisional only if held-out event and daily errors improve over price-free baseline; report contrary metrics and menu-specific failures. No topology or policy benefit inferred.
counterfactual: Unobserved menus require a separately declared response simulator; raw data contain only the observed menu response.

topology.gate: verify switches and internal observed-load compatibility; do not add artificial service impedances
